Nominal collector cadence is 1 Hz; actual timestamp gaps are recorded, and between-sample activity can be missed.
Collector probes and JSON serialization consume resources. Cost fields exist in raw records; no zero-overhead claim.
Tracker physical GPU backing is separate from NVML whole-device used bytes; neither attributes all VRAM to the engine.
NVML memoryPercent is memory read/write utilization, not memory capacity.
Native per-run tails and two paired differences are descriptive; no significance/confidence/causal regression claim.
Offline native audit verifies CSV/report counts and quantiles, recorded binaries, 28 authored inputs and result asset hashes; it does not verify complete shader/asset trees or visual correctness.

Nominal collector cadence is 1 Hz; actual timestamp gaps are recorded, and between-sample activity can be missed.
Collector probes and JSON serialization consume resources. Cost fields exist in raw records; no zero-overhead claim.
